snippet.title: Trip to the Core — Official Trailer | Wishlist NOW on Steam!
snippet.description:
Trip to the Core is a team-based roguelike deck builder where every run tells a different story. 
Pick 3 characters from 15 unique rebels, forge your deck, and fuse POG enhancer equipment into devastating combos across 5 procedurally generated acts.

 FEATURES:
- 15 unique characters — each with their own deck & playstyle
- Power Output Gear (POG) system — 150+ equipment combinations
- Team synergy — mix tanks, damage dealers & status specialists
- Procedurally generated maps across 5 acts
- Set in 2049 — take down the corporate rulers controlling humanity

This game is currently in development, but if you love Slay the Spire, Monster Train, or Cobalt Core, drop a wishlist and stay tuned for updates!
